前回も素敵なイラストをありがとうございました✨（もうほんと最高でした）　連続の依頼で大変恐縮なのですが宜しければお受けして頂けたらと思います。今回も全身イラストで神装束の衣装、構図としましてはURL先の前かがみになります！表情は笑顔とウインクしながら舌ペロしている表情の二種を可能であれば描いて頂きたいです！（網ノ札さんのアイコンにしている表情がベストです！）アクリルスタンドで飾りたいので今回も商用利用頂けたら大変うれしいです、、！！　納品はPSD及び透過PNGでも結構でございます！何卒ご検討の程お願いいたします！

https://jp.pinterest.com/pin/65443000830021873/

Hello, my name is Ekon Shimanaga, a Vtuber (in preparation).
I am a Vtuber (in preparation). I saw your illustration of the beautiful colors and I would like to ask you to draw it for me.

The details of the request are as follows
Character
Ekon Shimanaga
A company stockbreeder who loves good food, drinks and games.
Her hair is black with a crescent moon brooch on the back of her hand.
She wears a crescent moon brooch on the back of her hand.
Her nails are black, red, black, red, black, starting from her thumb.
There is no three-sided drawing, so you can draw the invisible parts as you like.
References:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1pBRVUFTBZVvhmeU1Wve9pY0kmm0OVbGL?usp=sharing

◆Situation, composition, etc.
If possible, we would like you to draw the whole body.
We will leave all other composition and design to you.

Usage
Icons and postings on SNS such as Twitter, etc.
Thumbnails, headers, videos, etc. for YouTube, twitch, etc.
We would like to use them for videos after monetization.
Commercial use in fanboxes (to be determined) and merchandising
If you have any NG items, we would appreciate it if you could describe them in a separate layer.
We will not use them for any other purposes.

Others
PSD format is preferred. It would be appreciated if you could separate the background, the person, and the signature and deliver them separately.

Thank you for your consideration.

お世話になっております。先日は素敵なイラストありがとうございます！
今回も宜しければ一枚絵を描いて頂きたくリクエストさせていただきました。

構図は神装束で仰向けでにこちらを見ているポーズです。
詳しいポージングの説明が難しくグラビアポーズの資料URLを載せていますのでご確認お願いします。
資料に寄せたポーズのイラストだと大変助かります。

資料はバスタブに入っている構図になっていますが、背景やバスタブなどは必要ございません。

また、表情は微笑む感じでお願いします。使用用途は前回と同じでサムネイルやXでの活用、アクリルスタンドなどのグッズ販売に差し支えなければ使用したいと考えております。

お忙しい中大変恐縮ではございますが宜しくお願いいたします！

Nice to meet you, my name is Yuzuki Akishino, a Vtuber.
I saw your wonderful illustration in the new arrivals list.
I would like to send you a request for an illustration of myself...!

I would like to ask for the following bunny outfit.
　（I would like you to dress me in the following bunny outfit (with or without tails, I leave that up to you).
I would like to use the illustration for my VTuber activities.
　(Icons, headers, thumbnails, videos, SNS, fan clubs, etc.)
We would appreciate it if you could use a separate layer for the address and background.
We would appreciate it if you could make sure that the left, right, and top layers are not cut off.

<Additional information
The breasts are modest.
The hair on the back reaches to the middle of the back.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate your cooperation...!

Nice to meet you here.
My name is Yui Izumo, a personal VTuber.
I would like to make a request as soon as possible for a sketch: 🙇‍♀️
I would like to use it for a thumbnail and goods such as an actor (if it is difficult, just a thumbnail is fine!). I will be using it as a thumbnail and goods such as acsta.

Please deliver the sketches as a single image without a background and with transparency.
The pose is with both hands in a "gao~" position! The expression on the face should be a slightly agitated grin, and the mouth should be open with one of the double teeth showing!

The thighs should be meaty! The costume will be the main divine costume!

Also, my three-sided and standing illustrations will be listed in the fixed post tree!

For reference of the pose and composition, I will attach the URL of the illustration of goods by Shakashaka Kuroe (the illustration on the left side with the gao~).
